script:
# Derive a welded, untextured geometry twin (HPG) from the Tripo tex8k-pbr GLB: node transforms baked into the meshes
# exactly as bl_util.import_glb_parts does, exact duplicate positions (UV-seam splits) merged (dist 1e-9 m), UVs,
# materials and normals dropped; nodes keep the names tripo_part_N. argv: <tex glb> <out glb>
import bpy, sys, bmesh
from mathutils import Matrix

argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
src, dst = argv[0], argv[1]
bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath=src)
objs = [o for o in bpy.context.scene.objects]
parts = [o for o in objs if o.type == "MESH"]
for o in parts:
    w = o.matrix_world.copy()
    o.parent = None
    o.data.transform(w)
    o.matrix_world = Matrix.Identity(4)
for o in objs:
    if o.type != "MESH":
        bpy.data.objects.remove(o)
for o in parts:
    name = o.name.split(".")[0]
    me = o.data
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bm.from_mesh(me)
    nf, nv = len(bm.faces), len(bm.verts)
    bmesh.ops.remove_doubles(bm, verts=bm.verts, dist=1e-9)
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    while me.uv_layers:
        me.uv_layers.remove(me.uv_layers[0])
    me.materials.clear()
    o.name = name
    me.name = name
    print("DERIVE", name, "faces", nf, "->", len(me.polygons), "verts", nv, "->", len(me.vertices))
bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=dst, export_format="GLB", export_materials="NONE", export_texcoords=False, export_tangents=False, export_vertex_color="NONE",
                          export_normals=False, export_apply=False, export_yup=True)
print("DERIVE_OK", dst)
